name: Specchio senza inganno
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original wide 16:9 full-bleed painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: A stark clear mountain spring reflecting every stone with perfect accuracy, a transparent unbroken prism beside a rough unpainted stone. Cool white, clear blue and honest natural surfaces. Keep the whole page naturally illustrated with a broad quiet darker central region for readable controls, never a blank rectangular panel. Matte hand-painted gouache, controlled anime fantasy shape design, believable organic detail and materials, no shiny 3D. First reference is ONLY brush technique: never copy its geography, composition, sunset, objects or sky. No solar disc or sky-eye. No Moon body in the sky. No coins, currency discs or round eye medallions. Clouds, only where naturally present, mix luminous BLUE dominant then INDIGO then VIOLET then PASTEL PINK. Vary architecture, scale, silhouette, viewpoint and lighting from the other themes. Tell the story through details alone. NO text, UI, writing, logos, signatures or watermarks.
